title: Grateful Dead Live at Pauley Pavilion - University of California on 1973-11-17

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of the legendary November 17 1973 UCLA show, highlighted by a tight set and a smoking Playin' In The Band sandwich with standout Here Come Sunshine and China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider.
ai_review.review: The recording is a superb soundboard mix – crisp, clean and arguably superior to other versions of this concert. Musically the band is in top form: Jerry’s solos blaze, the set flows flawlessly and classics like Here Come Sunshine, Looks Like Rain, China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider and the famed Playin' In The Band sandwich are cited as exceptional. Overall the performance feels tight, energetic and virtually error‑free.

ai_rating.rationale: All detailed reviews give 5‑star ratings praising both the musical performance and the soundboard recording; consistent high praise yields a near‑perfect combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clean mix with excellent clarity; reviewers note minor splices/patches on some tracks but overall superior to other IA sources. EQ recommended for best playback.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
Playin' In The Band > Uncle John's Band > Morning Dew > Uncle John's Band > Playin' In The Band (the sandwich)
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is described as solid from start to finish, with no weak moments; the famous Playin' In The Band sandwich provides a high‑point climax and the pacing feels tight and well‑structured.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia 'kicks it in on every solo', his picking is described as soaring and wailing, delivering inspired leads throughout.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith Godchaux’s honky‑tonk fills are praised; a reviewer also mentions a ‘Bobby’ contribution (likely misidentified) adding nice rhythm fills.
